async function run(groups, other, read, output) {
	for (const batch of groups) {
		// A synchronous prelude does not await.
		report(batch.length);
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		const rows = await Promise.all(
			batch.filter((item) => item.enabled).map(read),
		);
		output.push(...rows);
	}
	for (const batch of groups) {
		if (batch.length)
			output.push(
				// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
				...(await Promise.all(batch.filter((item) => item.enabled).map(read))),
			);
	}
	for (const batch of groups) {
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		await Promise.all(
			batch
				.filter((item) => item.enabled && item.readyForAnotherAttempt)
				.map((item) =>
					read(item, "a long collection argument that the formatter wraps"),
				),
		);
	}
	for (const batch of groups) {
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		const rows = await Promise.all(
			other.filter((item) => item.enabled).map(read),
		);
	}
	for (const item of other) {
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		const rows = await Promise.all([read(item), notify(item)]);
	}
	for (const batch of groups) {
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		await reportAsync(batch);
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		const rows = await Promise.all(
			batch.filter((item) => item.enabled).map(read),
		);
	}
}
async function first(groups, read) {
	for (const batch of groups)
		// ok: await-in-loop-javascript
		return await Promise.all(batch.filter((item) => item.enabled).map(read));
}
